verdict.rationale: MailerSend documents its own event-driven automation: inbound email routing uses rules to automatically parse and forward incoming mail, and webhooks automatically fire real-time event notifications to a registered URL with retries. However, the evidence shows no general rule or workflow builder that lets users define conditions and actions across arbitrary events. Missing for 10: a general-purpose trigger/condition/action rule engine, documentation of which rule conditions and actions are available, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Automatically parse and route incoming emails using rules and webhooks.
Webhooks allow you to subscribe to real-time notifications about various events that occur in MailerSend.
MailerSend automatically retries with exponential backoff for up to about 3 days.
